body.statement: For all \(G\equiv_E H\) and \(e\in E(H)\setminus E(G)\), \(G+e\equiv_E G\) for every \(e\in U_{\to}\cup U_{\leftrightarrow}\). This includes SCC-changing arrows, directed self-loops, unordered bidirected loops \(\{u,u\}\), arbitrary directed cycles, and bidirected additions outside occupied SCC rectangles.
body.justification: This local theorem resolves the global conjecture by iteration.
body.gap: No published E-result covers these unrestricted regimes.
body.consumer: Equivalent representatives become connected by safe edge additions.
